entities.summary: John Saville was a Greek-British Marxist historian, long associated with the University of Hull. He was an influential writer on British labour history in the second half of the twentieth century, and also known for his multi-volume work, the Dictionary of Labour Biography, edited in collaboration with others. John Saville was a journalists & chroniclers from Morton (1916-04-02, Morton–2009-06-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
